name: Milly Osworth
summary: Deputy Willem sends you across Northshire Abbey to help his friend Milly Osworth. Her wagon and livelihood are in danger, and Willem's guards cannot leave the abbey grounds to help.

sections.title: A Dependable Pair of Hands
sections.body: After you drive back the Defias thieves pressing into Northshire Valley, Deputy Willem trusts you with a personal favor. His friend Milly Osworth is a civilian caught in the valley's unrest, and helping her falls beyond his guard duties.

sections.title: Trouble by the Stables
sections.body: Milly waits beside her wagon near the stables on the far side of Northshire Abbey. Deputy Willem stays at his post to defend the abbey. With the guard garrison stretched thin, Milly's troubles in the valley go without help.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Milly Osworth?
aliases: where to get milly osworth quest
faq.answer: Deputy Willem sends you to Milly after you prove reliable against the Defias bandits.

faq.q: Where can Milly Osworth be found?
faq.answer: Milly waits beside her wagon on the far side of Northshire Abbey, near the stables and the vineyards to the southeast.

faq.q: Why can't Deputy Willem help Milly himself?
faq.answer: Willem's guard duties keep him at Northshire Abbey. Bandits and vermin press the valley, leaving the garrison too few hands for private civilian troubles.

faq.q: What prerequisites are needed for this quest?
aliases: how to unlock milly osworth quest
faq.answer: You need to complete Brotherhood of Thieves for Deputy Willem before he trusts you to help Milly.

faq.q: What does Milly need help with?
faq.answer: Milly is struggling with her crop and wagon amid the local turmoil. Her harvest needs protection from the surrounding valley.

faq.q: Who is Milly Osworth to Deputy Willem?
faq.answer: Willem calls Milly a friend in need from the Northshire community. He looks out for her while bound to his post.

angles.text: In Northshire, you see Alliance guards stretched thin and relying on passing adventurers to protect townspeople from emerging threats.
As a young human in Northshire, you can help Willem and show the community spirit that helps hold Elwynn together.
